snapshot: Per-point climatological baseline for the fire-weather factor W
why: W = clamp(0.6 + 0.25*sum(z), 0.6, 1.6) has its floor at the mean, so a zero-centred baseline pins it flat onto 0.6. A full annual cycle puts fire season above the yearly mean and lets W vary.

sources.name: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive
sources.note: Free, no API key. Deliberately not Visual Crossing: the live series spends that provider's daily record budget.

caveat: Baseline provider differs from the live series provider (Visual Crossing). ERA5 reanalysis and an observation blend can differ systematically, which biases the z-scores; per-variable means are recorded in the snapshot so this stays auditable.
